# Synthetic document regression fixtures

These files contain generated test content only, with no user documents or
credentials. They test byte-preserving upload of genuine document containers.

- sample.pdf: two pages generated by ReportLab with invariant metadata. The
  first page includes Chinese text. pypdf read both pages and extracted the
  expected page labels during generation.
- sample.docx: created by python-docx with Chinese/English paragraphs, apostrophes,
  and a two-column table. It was saved, reopened, edited, saved again, and
  reopened to confirm the appended paragraph. ZIP timestamps and document
  created/modified metadata are fixed to January 1, 2000.

The portable Go tests read these committed bytes and validate multipart uploads
without requiring Python or sending requests to the actual provider.
